notes.title: It's Troll Time! - New devlog is out!
notes.content:
[p]We have just posted our latest devlog, called "It's TROLL time!"

In this devlog we show some of the latest development about combat, graphics, artificial intelligence and more!

Check it out![/p][previewyoutube="cLtrap5-e40;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Ascent Quest is currently made [b]by only two developpers[/b], we are looking for developers and financial support to increase team size and make this game a truly amazing experience. And we share with the community our progress!

If you like to follow game development but also love to suggest features or ideas for games, we've opened a "Feature Upvote" page!

[url="https://ascentquest.featureupvote.com/"]https://ascentquest.featureupvote.com/[/url]

Here you can read other players suggestions and upvote the one you like the most.
Want to talk more about it? Don't hesitate to join our growing community on Discord!

[url="https://discord.gg/stahWj6t9E"]https://discord.gg/stahWj6t9E[/url]

See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Devlog #8 and character creation preview are out!
notes.content:
The new DevLog #8 was publised a few weeks ago!
This time, we were focusing on a few different things that weren't really presented in previous DevLogs, namely: 

⚒️ crafting, gathering 🌿 
and several minor but no less important features!

[previewyoutube=q3m5GMLZX4E;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also published a first preview of our work in progress character creation, you can have a look here :

[previewyoutube=wLSpkam_Qys;full][/previewyoutube]

As usual, everything we show is under development, so just because we show it on video doesn't mean it's finished. We're in the middle of preparing the first alpha, and a lot of things are still going to change. Don't forget to share the videos to help us spread the word about the project!

Thank you!

notes.title: New specialization reveal: The Assassin!
notes.content:
Hi dear community!

It is time to reveal an aditionnal specialization we've been working on: [b]The Assassin![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44569285/b20ef2c3abd9d7337eaf6ad7badd7828430a90bc.jpg[/img]

Initially part of the stretch goals on Kickstarter, we were hesitant to include it for the first game release as it needed to create some unique stealth mechanics. But after tests and reflexion, we decided to include this iconic class into Ascent Quest as part of the first wave of specializations. We'll show it in action once its development is more advanced.

A new page has been added to the website to present all specializations with their theme and main skill (likely to change based on feed back we'll get during the future alpha and beta). We are creating more pages to explain all the mechanics of the game if you missed our Devlogs.

Have a look, here ! https://www.ascent-quest.com/classes/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44569285/6c531e52251fa2630cdbad0778e1d724f57d1a19.jpg[/img]

Last thing, we've just announced the launch of [url=https://www.ascent-quest.com/2024/09/21/project-support-packs-are-now-available/]the Game Supporter Packs[/url] sales last week-end. If you missed the Kickstarter and wanted to support us, this is the best way to do it! The Steam pre-purchase will be available later when we approach the beta-test.

Thank you!

notes.title: Devlog #07 available!
notes.content:
Hi Steam community!

Did you know that we post regular devlogs so you can follow the evolution of the game during its development?
It's time for a new one!
We show a work in progress preview of the very first story boss and talk about how we implement melee combat in Ascent Quest!

[b]All footages are from a game in early development. [u]Everything will be improved[/u], including the physic in combat. It is by no way the final look & feel of the game.[/b]

Don't hesitate to comment or join us on Discord to share your ideas!
You can find all previous devlogs on our Youtube channel.

[previewyoutube=BWFdczYA9fg;full][/previewyoutube]
